notes: Desktop personal monitor mixer (part of the Behringer Powerplay 16 system, alongside the separate 1U-rack P16-I input module and P16-D Ultranet distributor, which are different SKUs). Dimensions approx. 63 x 257 x 134 mm (H x W x D), 0.8 kg — not rack-mountable itself, so rackUnits omitted. Ultranet In/Thru are physical RJ45 jacks carrying Behringer's proprietary Ultranet digital-audio protocol over shielded CAT5, not standard Ethernet, so no eth-x grade was assigned (spec sheet gives no Ethernet bandwidth class). Line Out is 2x unbalanced 1/4" TS jacks (labeled L/MONO and R) — separate from the stereo 1/4" TRS Phones jack. MIDI In accepts standard 5-pin DIN MIDI cables for external controller/remote parameter control. Data cross-verified against two independent hostings of Behringer's own Powerplay 16 Quick Start Guide/manual (identical official spec table): Markertek (used as sourceUrl, on the approved retailer list) and manuals.plus. Could not reach behringer.com directly (product page 404s, likely delisted since the P16-M appears end-of-life/out of production) or Sweetwater/B&H/Crutchfield (403s on automated fetch), so used the Markertek-hosted copy of Behringer's own manual/spec sheet instead — content is the manufacturer's, confidence kept high since the full official specifications table (Audio Connections, Power Supply, Dimensions/Weight) was directly read.

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: Power input for included external power-supply adaptor; barrel connector inferred from rear-panel photography (official spec sheet lists only 'external power supply adaptor', max 5W, without stating jack diameter). Unit can alternatively be bus-powered over the Ultranet RJ45 link from a P16-I or P16-D.
